# crossplane

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/pkg/secrets/github/crossplane"
```

Package crossplane reconciles the Crossplane GitHub provider credential secret — a cluster\-scoped ExternalSecret consumed by the Crossplane GitHub \(Upjet\) provider in crossplane\-system. It is not owned by any CR and has no teardown: the provider is a platform singleton, not a per\-resource lifecycle.
